name: brain
constraints: Brain is external; do not assume the brain binary is installed
do not store secrets in Brain
use ask before note when checking prior context

name: data-flywheel
constraints: local-only by default
human-approved runs only
redaction required before trainable
do not train models

name: data-layer
constraints: local-only by default
no screenshot delivery without explicit user approval
do not commit private .agent/data-layer exports

name: debug-investigator
constraints: reproduce before fixing
fix root cause, not symptoms

name: deploy-checklist
constraints: all tests passing
no unresolved TODOs in diff
requires human approval for production

name: design-md
constraints: prefer DESIGN.md tokens over invented values
do not modify DESIGN.md unless the user explicitly asks
preserve unknown sections when an edit IS authorised
validate when tooling is available

name: git-proxy
constraints: never force push to main
never force push to protected branches
run tests before push

name: live-service-tests
description: Gated tests against a real external service: env-var tiers, self-cleaning writes, run-unique ids, and the port-boundary defaults a fake cannot prove.

name: loop-constraints
constraints: read contracts and state before acting
deny paths and approvals are fail-closed

name: loop-guard
constraints: read contracts and state before acting
stop on budget or stagnation decisions

name: loop-triage
constraints: read the selected contract and checkpoint before acting
remain read-only

name: loop-verifier
constraints: read contracts and state before acting
run deterministic checks exactly as configured

name: memory-manager
constraints: do not delete high-salience entries
do not merge personal into semantic

name: session-audit
description: Audit delivered work for gaps: split the surface into MECE areas and verify each with a command, never from memory.

name: skillforge
constraints: do not duplicate existing skills
always include self-rewrite hook

name: tldraw
constraints: call get_canvas before update_shape or delete_shape
at most 200 shapes per create_shape call
coordinates within 0..1600 x 0..900 unless told otherwise

name: verify-by-breaking
description: Prove a test or guard catches the failure it claims to catch: break it, watch it fail, restore it.

name: ztk
note: pinned 2026-09-03 from home brain winner (was absent from all framework manifests)
